SELECT a.menu_idx, a.menu_name, b.menu_url, a.menu_icon FROM dn_menu_top AS a LEFT JOIN dn_menu_in AS b ON a.menu_idx = b.menu_idx AND a.menu_num = b.menu_num WHERE a.menu_use = 1
AND b.menu_level IN ('1','2','3','4')
AND b.menu_level IN ('2','3','4')
AND b.menu_level IN ('3','4')
AND b.menu_level IN ('4')

SELECT b.menu_idx, b.menu_num, b.menu_name, b.menu_url, b.menu_level FROM dn_menu_top AS a LEFT JOIN dn_menu_in AS b ON a.menu_idx = b.menu_idx WHERE a.menu_use = 1 AND b.menu_use = 1
AND b.menu_level IN ('1','2','3','4')
